description: Categorical text field representing race/ethnicity values. The column is complete with 0 missing values out of 30 records and contains 6 distinct non-null values. Observed values show inconsistent casing for the same categories, including 'Malay', 'MALAY', and 'malay', as well as 'Indian' and 'indian'.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Standardize case-only variations affecting at least 13.3% of records by aligning values to a single approved casing convention: 'MALAY' → 'Malay', 'malay' → 'Malay', 'indian' → 'Indian'.
